PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Work with Agile Team to translate business requirements into practical software solutions and meet stated objectives 
Delivering a complete front end application 
Writing tested, idiomatic, and documented JavaScript, HTML and CSS 
Translate project design into code using Angular JS, JavaScript, JQuery, JSON and HTML / CSS 
Work across technical areas and with other teams to ensure that the best new technologies are investigated and selected for use 
Coordinate with onshore and offshore developers to ensure timely & quality delivery 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

6+ years of experience as UI Developer/ Front End Engineer 
3+ years of experience as Angular JS Developer& JQuery 
Strong UI development experience with HTML5/CSS3, AngularJS, NODE JS, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, JSON 
Strong in using 3rd Party tools like Bootstrap, Handlebar JS, JQUNIT and GruntJs 
Experience with Unit and E2E testing with Angular App using Karma, Jasmine and Protactor 
Experience in Test Driven Development and Task Automation 
Experience using JQuery, bootstrap, and font awesome 
Experience with the entire software Experience using Eclipse IDE 
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a team setting 
Ability to handle multiple tasks and the flexibility to respond to changing priorities and timelines and demands.


 JQuery,JavaScript, HTML and CSS 


 Only GC/Citizen
